definitions.explanation: A chemical substance used for medical treatment or one that affects the body physiologically. In modern usage, frequently associated with illegal or controlled substances and drug abuse.

notes:
USAGE:
While technically neutral (meaning any pharmaceutical substance), in practice {薬物|やくぶつ} often carries a negative connotation and is strongly associated with illegal drugs and substance abuse. For everyday medicine, ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: medicine (everyday word)
- {薬物|やくぶつ}: drug/substance (often implies illegal or controlled substances)
- ⟦{薬剤|やくざい}→薬剤：14100_yakuzai⟧: pharmaceutical, medication (technical/professional)
